repository: Public repository containing the Jav client configuration files.

blockedCommands.helm: helm is blocked. Edit the HelmRelease in shockstruck/k8s-gitops; do not bypass Flux.
blockedCommands.talosctl: talosctl is blocked. Talos changes are Git-reviewed and applied only with explicit operator approval and a rollback.
blockedCommands.sops: sops is blocked. Do not decrypt or print secret material in an agent session.
